title: Sets as Euler Diagram
limitation: No shape-containment or disjointness relation; a static nested-circle arrangement must be authored directly.

title: Quaternions as table
limitation: Cells and labels can be enumerated, but there are no collections, grid layout, or reusable table rules.

title: Walk on Stars - Signed Angle Outside
limitation: Angle arcs exist, but the star boundary, repeated signed-angle construction, and sampling must be expanded manually.

title: Hypercube
limitation: Nodes and edges are drawable, but there is no graph data model, loop, or automatic layout.

title: Quaternions as Cayley graph
limitation: Bent arrows are available, but group expansion, repeated styling rules, and graph layout are manual.

title: Sets as Euler Diagram in 2.5D
limitation: The figure depends on imported SVG shading, layering, and pseudo-3D effects.

title: A Caffeine Molecule
limitation: The bond graph is drawable, but molecule rules, automatic layout, image-based shading, and blur are absent.

title: Walk on Stars - Laplace Estimator
limitation: The central result needs generated walks, custom SVG assets, polygonal domains, and simulation-specific computation.

title: Mobius Transformation of Circles
limitation: Circles can be placed, but Locus has no Mobius transform or reusable mapping rule.

title: Insertion Sort
limitation: Boxes and arrows are drawable, but arrays, indexed expansion, and state-to-state generation are manual.

title: Hexagonal Lattice Graph
limitation: The lattice can be enumerated, but generation and spectral layout are absent.

title: 3D Reflections and Shadows
limitation: Locus has no 3D projection, lighting, reflection, shadow, or blur model.

title: Computer Network with Multiple One-Way Links
limitation: Directed bent edges are supported, but parallel-edge routing and graph layout must be authored manually.

title: Two 3D Triangles
limitation: The defining perspective projection and 3D triangle geometry are outside the language.

title: Random Sampling
limitation: A fixed sample can be enumerated, but random distributions and collection generation are absent.

title: Catmull-Rom Interpolation Test
limitation: Locus has only open uniform cubic B-splines; it cannot express Catmull-Rom interpolation or custom knots.

title: Word Cloud
limitation: Per-label font sizing, rotation, and global word-cloud collision layout are unavailable.

title: Lagrange Bases
limitation: Polynomial evaluation and curve sampling must be expanded into individual points and segments.

title: Hypergraph
limitation: Nodes are drawable, but smooth multi-node hyperedges need arbitrary closed paths or manual substitutes.

title: Persistent Homology
limitation: Circle filtrations can be drawn, but staged data rules, translucent overlap shading, and imported SVG shading are missing.

title: Walk on Spheres - Laplace Estimator
limitation: The defining stochastic process, 3D-style assets, and generated walk geometry are unavailable.

title: Hamiltonian Cycle
limitation: A fixed highlighted cycle is drawable, but the graph abstraction and automatic layout are absent.

title: Methane Combustion Reaction
limitation: A static reaction is possible, but molecule templates, atom/bond rules, and chemical layout are manual.

title: Matrix-matrix multiplication
limitation: The grid can be authored, but matrices, indexed products, and generated highlights are absent.

title: Half Adder
limitation: Conventional logic-gate bodies require arbitrary closed paths and routed connectors not present in Locus.

title: Curved graph example with dots
limitation: Quadratic arrow bends exist, but arbitrary polyline routing and graph layout are manual.

title: Fancy Text + Equations
limitation: Mixed plain text and TeX work, but per-label fonts, sizes, rotations, and rich typographic styles do not.

title: Blobs
limitation: Locus has no closed or fitted spline and cannot fill an open B-spline.

title: Ray Casting
limitation: Generic ray intersections against ellipses, polygons, polylines, and rectangles are unavailable.

title: Next Event Estimation
limitation: The example combines 3D projection, imported assets, and ray-tracing-specific computations.

title: Geometric Queries
limitation: Generic closest-point, silhouette-point, and ray-intersection operations across shape types are missing.

title: Closest Point Queries
limitation: Locus supports selected projections, not generic nearest points for ellipses, polygons, polylines, and rectangles.

title: Brownian Motion in a Ball
limitation: A fixed path can be drawn, but Brownian sampling, boundary handling, and imported shading are absent.

title: Brownian Motion Absorbed at Boundary
limitation: A fixed path can be drawn, but the absorbing process and generated path are absent.

title: Dodecahedral Graph
limitation: The 2D node-edge result is drawable, but graph generation, spectral layout, and glow effects are absent.

title: Mobius Strip
limitation: A projected twisted surface with depth ordering is outside Locus's 2D object model.

title: Impossible Polygons
limitation: The figure relies on arbitrary paths, gradients, blur, imported SVG, and explicit layer ordering.

title: Lyapunov Exponent
limitation: The Lyapunov computation and dense generated curve/path cannot be expressed without functions and iteration.

title: Chaos Game: Sierpinski Triangle
limitation: A finite snapshot can be enumerated, but random iteration and bulk point generation are absent.

title: Iterated Functions System
limitation: A finite snapshot can be sampled manually, but affine iteration and collections are absent.

title: Nephroid as Envelope of Circles
limitation: Individual circles and lines exist, but the parametric family and envelope generation require loops and functions.

title: Linear Regression
limitation: Points and a line are drawable, but datasets, regression, axes, and repeated marks are manual.

title: Ellipse Rays
limitation: The central ellipse-ray intersection/reflection computation and interactive updates are unavailable.

title: Viewport
limitation: The figure requires a camera, 3D projection, cursor interaction, and dynamic recomputation.

title: Planets
limitation: A static orbit diagram is possible, but animation and interaction are unavailable.
